cost.description: LaDe Hangzhou V2 M5 reference costing, researched 2026-09-30. Same operating rates as the B1 profile. Mixed-year public proxies and explicit unmeasured assumptions; not LaDe accounts. Diesel light-vehicle counterfactual. Container depreciation follows actual uses, not operating days. Initial investment is reported separately and must not be added to allocated depreciation in a cash-flow total. No empirical return-loss process is implemented.
